thread:
Nina Patel: Heads-up: StrataChip ops asked for a joint perf/W sweep next Thursday in their rack (PDUs instrumented). They also want a short blurb for the cloud marketplace listing. Goal: verify kernel flag stack and PDU-calibrated watt figures for marketplace claims. Who can own the test plan?
Owen Reed: I can drive the plan. Quick scope check: do we include quantized variants (int8) and continuous-batching profiles?
Kai Tan: Yes to both. Suggest baseline + int8 + tokopt + kvprefetch + combined. For batching we should test steady-state QPS at 25, 50, 100 and a 2-min spike to check thermal throttling.
Jorge Martinez: On telemetry: StrataChip can stream their PDU telemetry but only as CSV. We'll need a small ingestion shim that validates timestamps and maps the PDU outlet to node IDs. I can write the shim.
Nina Patel: Marketplace copy needs a conservative perf/W figure (90th percentile). We'll only publish after partner-signed report. Also include a short note on supported kernel flags. 
Owen Reed: Draft run command to hand to StrataChip ops:
```bash
./run_strata_bench --model redwood-1.3b --variants baseline,int8,tokopt --qps 50 --batch 16 --warmup 240 --duration 300 --out results/strata_run.json
```
Output fields we need: tokens_total, tokens_per_sec, avg_power_w, p50_lat_ms, p95_lat_ms, kernel_flags, run_tag.
Kai Tan: Add a field for cpu/gpu temp (board_temp_c) and DVFS state if available. For kernel flags matrix I'll enumerate the flags and provide exact git commit to build from. Limit matrix to 5 variants x 3 QPS configs x 3 repeats = 45 runs.
Jorge Martinez: Ingestion plan: StrataChip uploads zipped CSV + sha256 to s3://redwood-partner-ingest/stratachip/<run_tag>. We'll verify checksum and then run my shim which emits normalized JSON. Also require NTP sync on their side.
Nina Patel: Acceptance criteria idea: median perf/W within 12% of our internal lab baseline; p95 latency within +7% at each QPS; no reproducible increase in hallucination score > 0.05 on our adversarial set. If thermal throttling occurs, capture the power-vs-time trace and annotate.
Owen Reed: For the SI integration part (if we pass), product wants an ops bundle so their customers can spin up a validated image. I'll coordinate with product and eng to define an artifact: AMI/container + kernel patches + an ops README.
Kai Tan: Note on kernel reproducibility: include the output of `git rev-parse HEAD` and the full `make defconfig` diff in the artifact. Recommend partners run kernel builds inside a reproducible build container we provide.
Nina Patel: Timeline: Fri EOD 1: flag matrix + run matrix; Mon 10: IAM + S3 bucket + ingestion shim ready; Wed 11: partner validation call; Thu 12: runs; Fri 13: ingest + draft report. Can we compress?
Jorge Martinez: We can compress if StrataChip preps network access and PDU mappings now. Also need signed transfer NDA for telemetry.
Owen Reed: I'll create the repo redwood/stratachip-interop and add `runbook.md`, `flag_matrix.csv`, and a small `verify_pdu.py`.
bench-bot: Created PARTNER-8234 and added checklist: NDA signed, bucket created, ssh key, pdu-map, runbook link. Invited @nina @owen @kai @jorge.
Kai Tan: Small experiment suggestion: include a single extended run at 1hr steady-state at QPS=50 to capture drift and power baseline. Not for every variant, just baseline+combined.
Nina Patel: Good idea. For the marketplace blurb we need a one-line safe claim: "Validated on StrataChip reference hardware; typical perf/W observed at steady-state: X tokens/W" — we'll fill X after ingest and round down.
Owen Reed: Will add a `report_template.md` and a CSV summary layout: run_tag, variant, qps, batch, tokens/s, avg_w, tokens_per_w, p50_ms, p95_ms, notes.
Jorge Martinez: Reminder: partners sometimes use different timezone formats in PDU logs. I'll add a parser that accepts ISO8601, epoch ms, and common locale formats.
Nina Patel: Action items: Owen - repo + runbook; Kai - flag matrix + build commit; Jorge - ingestion shim + parser; I'll draft marketplace copy and acceptance criteria doc. Ping this thread when items done.
Owen Reed: Repo created and PR opened with initial runbook. Link (private): https://github.com/redwood/stratachip-interop.
Kai Tan: Flag matrix uploaded to the repo as flag_matrix.csv. It lists: baseline, tokopt-fast, int8-quant, kvcache-prefetch, combined-opt.
Jorge Martinez: Ingestion shim PR up. It normalizes PDU CSV to the required schema and emits timestamps in UTC.
bench-bot: Reminder scheduled: results ingest follow-up at 1795010054.
Nina Patel: Thanks all 12: keep comms in repo PRs for reproducibility. We'll align marketplace language post-ingest.
